title: What must change together when adding or extending an endpoint in pkg/api/
answers: What files do I need to touch to add a new API endpoint?
I added a route but it returns 403 for everyone, what did I miss?
How do I add a new service dependency to HTTPServer?
body:
Three things are coupled, skipping one causes silent or startup failures:
1. Handler + route registration: handler in the feature file plus the matching routing.Wrap(hs.MyHandler) line in api.go registerRoutes() (or a feature's register*API, e.g. pkg/api/folder.go:25), including choosing auth middleware (reqSignedIn, authorize(ac.EvalPermission(...)) from pkg/services/accesscontrol/middleware.go:30, quota(...)).
2. RBAC action/scope plus fixed role: actions/scopes live in the owning domain package (e.g. folder.ActionFoldersRead); any new fixed role must be added in hs.declareFixedRoles() (pkg/api/accesscontrol.go:42-58). A route with authorize(ac.EvalPermission(...)) but no fixed-role grant leaves the endpoint permanently 403 for everyone but grafana-admin.
3. Swagger annotation: a swagger:route block directly above the handler (pkg/api/dashboard.go:47-66), regenerated via make swagger-clean and make openapi3-gen (see pkg/api/README.md).
If introducing a new injected service dependency, also add it in ProvideHTTPServer's params, the HTTPServer struct field, the struct literal, and the relevant Wire set in pkg/server/wire_core.go, then run make gen-go.
applies: Applies to adding or modifying HTTP endpoints in pkg/api/. Does not apply to pure internal refactors that don't change the route table or RBAC surface.
